theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (C X : List ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym),   (∀ (fresh cs : Bool), ATK.SatNPSemantica.evalStart C fresh cs false X = false) ∧     ∀ (p : Bool) (I : List ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym) (cs : Bool), ATK.SatNPSemantica.evalIdx C p I cs false X = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: eval_sound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (C X : List ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym),   (∀ (all : Bool),       ATK.SatNPSemantica.evalStart C true false all X = true →         ∃ φ, X = ATK.SatNPSemantica.encCNF φ ∧ all = true ∧ List.all φ (ATK.SatNPSemantica.clauseVal C) = true) ∧     (∀ (cs all : Bool),         ATK.SatNPSemantica.evalStart C false cs all X = true →           ∃ K φ,             X = List.flatMap ATK.SatNPSemantica.encLit K ++ A

theorems_only_on_branches.name: idxSym_injective
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: Function.Injective ATK.SatNPSemantica.idxSym

theorems_only_on_branches.name: lookup_encSegs
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (τ : ℕ → Bool) (L : List ATK.ModeloPNP.Literal),   ∀ i ∈ List.map Prod.fst L,     ATK.SatNPSemantica.lookup (ATK.SatNPSemantica.idxSym i)         (List.flatMap (fun ℓ => ATK.SatNPSemantica.encSeg τ ℓ.1) L) =       τ i

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ofBits_bits
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ATK.SatNPSemantica.ofBits n.bits = n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: sat_em_NP_de
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime ATK.LigacaoPNP.cod Computability.encodeBool ATK.SatNPSemantica.verif),   ATK.ModeloPNP.SAT ∈ ATK.LigacaoPNP.classeNP

theorems_only_on_branches.name: sat_iff_verif
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : ATK.LigacaoPNP.Palavra),   x ∈ ATK.ModeloPNP.SAT ↔ ∃ c, List.length c ≤ List.length x ∧ ATK.SatNPSemantica.verif (ATK.LigacaoPNP.par x c) = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: satisfaz_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (C : List ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym) (φ : ATK.ModeloPNP.CNF),   ATK.ModeloPNP.Satisfaz (ATK.SatNPSemantica.tau C) φ ↔ List.all φ (ATK.SatNPSemantica.clauseVal C) = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: seg_append
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (r l : List ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym),   (∀ s ∈ l, s.1 = false) → ATK.SatNPSemantica.seg (l ++ ATK.SatNPSemantica.sL :: r) = (l, r)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: sym_eq_of_fst
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (s : ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym), s.1 = false → s = (false, s.2)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: sym_eq_sL
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (s : ATK.SatNPSemantica.Sym), s ≠ ATK.SatNPSemantica.sC → s.1 = true → s = ATK.SatNPSemantica.sL

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_cert
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (τ : ℕ → Bool) (φ : ATK.ModeloPNP.CNF),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (ATK.SatNPSemantica.cert τ φ) =     List.flatMap (fun ℓ => ATK.SatNPSemantica.encSeg τ ℓ.1) (List.flatten φ)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_codCNF
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (φ : ATK.ModeloPNP.CNF), ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ) = ATK.SatNPSemantica.encCNF φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_codClausula
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (K : ATK.ModeloPNP.Clausula) (r : List Bool),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (ATK.ModeloPNP.codClausula K ++ r) =     ATK.SatNPSemantica.encClause K ++ ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_codLiteral
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ATK.ModeloPNP.Literal) (r : List Bool),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (ATK.ModeloPNP.codLiteral ℓ ++ r) = ATK.SatNPSemantica.encLit ℓ ++ ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_codSeg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (τ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (r : List Bool),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (ATK.SatNPSemantica.codSeg τ i ++ r) =     ATK.SatNPSemantica.encSeg τ i ++ ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_cons_cons
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (a b : Bool) (r : List Bool), ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (a :: b :: r) = (a, b) :: ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_flatMap_simb
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (l r : List Bool),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms (List.flatMap ATK.ModeloPNP.simb l ++ r) =     List.map (fun b => (false, b)) l ++ ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: syms_inj
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x y : List Bool}, x.length % 2 = 0 → y.length % 2 = 0 → ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms x = ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms y → x = y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: unsyms_syms
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool), x.length % 2 = 0 → ATK.SatNPSemantica.unsyms (ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms x) = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: verif_codCNF
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (φ : ATK.ModeloPNP.CNF) (c : List Bool),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.verif (ATK.LigacaoPNP.par (ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ) c) =     List.all φ (ATK.SatNPSemantica.clauseVal (ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms c))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: verif_par_sound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x c : ATK.LigacaoPNP.Palavra),   ATK.SatNPSemantica.verif (ATK.LigacaoPNP.par x c) = true →     ∃ φ, x = ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ ∧ ATK.ModeloPNP.Satisfaz (ATK.SatNPSemantica.tau (ATK.SatNPSemantica.syms c)) φ
